{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000030QJW3TT8REHH","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram flow=down
group core "Plugin runtime" {
  node Manager "PluginManager" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/core/plugin-manager"
  node Plugin "Plugin" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/core/plugin.ts"
  node ActGraph "Activation Graph" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/core/plugin-manager/activation-graph.ts"
  node Events "ActivationEvents" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/common/activation-events.ts"
  node Capability "Capability" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/core/capability.ts"
  node CapMgr "CapabilityManager" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/core/capability-manager.ts"
}
group consumers "Consumers" {
  node Surface "Surface" ref="packages/sdk/app-framework/src/ui/components/Surface"
  node Operation "OperationInvoker" ref="packages/core/compute/operation/src/OperationInvoker.ts"
  node AppGraph "App Graph" ref="packages/sdk/app-graph/src/AppGraph.ts"
  node Toolkit "App Toolkit" ref="packages/sdk/app-toolkit/src/app-framework"
}
group shell "Shell plugins" {
  node Deck "Deck" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-deck"
  node Navtree "NavTree" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-navtree"
}
edge Manager owns Plugin "loads"
edge Manager owns ActGraph "schedules"
edge ActGraph -> Events "fires on"
edge Plugin composes Capability "contributes"
edge Manager owns CapMgr
edge Surface -> CapMgr
edge Operation -> CapMgr
edge AppGraph -> CapMgr
edge Toolkit -> Plugin
edge Deck -> AppGraph
edge Deck -> Surface "articles"
edge Navtree -> AppGraph
"},"objects":[
